<div class="pvme-exact-guide">
<h1 id="how-the-site-works" class="pvme-source-title"><nowiki>How The Site Works</nowiki></h1>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Full process on </nowiki>[https://github.com/pvme/pvme.github.io <nowiki>Github</nowiki>]<nowiki>, and in short:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<ol><nowiki>
</nowiki><li><nowiki>Gather the </nowiki><code><nowiki>.txt</nowiki></code><nowiki> guides from the </nowiki>[https://github.com/pvme/pvme-guides <nowiki>pvme-guides repository</nowiki>]<nowiki>.</nowiki></li><nowiki>
</nowiki><li><nowiki>Format </nowiki><code><nowiki>.txt</nowiki></code><nowiki> -&gt; </nowiki><code><nowiki>.md</nowiki></code><nowiki>.</nowiki></li><nowiki>
</nowiki><li><nowiki>Build the website from the </nowiki><code><nowiki>.md</nowiki></code><nowiki> files using </nowiki>[https://squidfunk.github.io/mkdocs-material <nowiki>MKDocs Material</nowiki>]<nowiki>.</nowiki></li><nowiki>
</nowiki></ol>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="limitations"><nowiki>Limitations</nowiki></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>First and foremost, the guides on the website are always up-to-date with the PvME Discord Server.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>This is because both are using the </nowiki><code><nowiki>.txt</nowiki></code><nowiki> guides from the </nowiki>[https://github.com/pvme/pvme-guides <nowiki>pvme-guides repository</nowiki>]<nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>With that being said, the </nowiki><code><nowiki>.txt</nowiki></code><nowiki> formatting is primarily aimed at Discord which can lead to some content showing incorrectly:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<ul><nowiki>
</nowiki><li><nowiki>References to social Discord exclusive channels (</nowiki><span><nowiki>#pvm-help</nowiki></span><nowiki>)</nowiki></li><nowiki>
</nowiki><li><nowiki>Mentions of </nowiki><code><nowiki>$linkmsg</nowiki></code></li><nowiki>
</nowiki></ul>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>I try to stay ahead of this by adding formatting rules that exclude or change Discord-only content.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>If you find any formatting issues, please message me on Discord (Pleb#0025) or create an issue on </nowiki>[https://github.com/pvme/pvme.github.io <nowiki>Github</nowiki>]<nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
      
    </nowiki>
